# PayGuard — Architecture Reference

---

## System Overview

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GEN["🏭 Producer\nproducer/generator.py\nSynthetic transactions\n95% normal · 5% fraud"]
    KAFKA[("📨 Kafka\nKRaft · topic: transactions")]
    CON["⚙️ Consumer\nconsumer/consumer.py\nKafka → inference → PostgreSQL"]
    INF["🧠 Inference Sidecar\ninference/app.py\nONNX IsolationForest\nFeature engineering"]
    PG[("🗄️ PostgreSQL\ntransaction_audit\nAudit log + ground truth")]
    API["🔌 REST API\napi/main.py\nFastAPI + asyncpg\nX-API-Key auth"]
    DASH["🖥️ Dashboard\nfrontend/\nReact + Recharts + GSAP\nWebSocket live feed"]

    GEN -->|"aiokafka\nJSON events"| KAFKA
    KAFKA -->|"aiokafka consumer\ngroup: payguard-consumer"| CON
    CON -->|"POST /score\nraw transaction"| INF
    INF -->|"anomaly_score\ndecision: flag/review/clear"| CON
    CON -->|"asyncpg\nINSERT/UPSERT"| PG
    PG -->|"SELECT"| API
    API -->|"JSON REST\nWS /ws"| DASH
    API -->|"POST /score\nproxy"| INF
```

## FastAPI ↔ PostgreSQL Endpoint Map

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    CLIENT["Client\n(Dashboard / curl)"]

    subgraph API["api/main.py"]
        HEALTH["GET /health\n⚠️ no auth"]
        TXN["GET /api/transactions\n?limit=N"]
        FLAG["GET /api/flagged"]
        STATS["GET /api/stats\nprecision/recall/F1"]
        SCORE["POST /api/score\nproxy + audit write"]
        WS["WS /ws\nlive flagged stream"]
    end

    subgraph PG["PostgreSQL · transaction_audit"]
        TBL[("transaction_id PK\nuser_id · amount\nmerchant_category\nanomaly_score\ndecision\nground_truth_label\nfraud_type\ncreated_at\n\nidx: (user_id, created_at DESC)\nidx: decision")]
    end

    INF_SIDE["Inference\nSidecar\n:8000"]

    CLIENT -->|"X-API-Key"| HEALTH
    CLIENT -->|"X-API-Key"| TXN
    CLIENT -->|"X-API-Key"| FLAG
    CLIENT -->|"X-API-Key"| STATS
    CLIENT -->|"X-API-Key"| SCORE
    CLIENT -->|"WS (no auth)"| WS

    TXN  --> TBL
    FLAG --> TBL
    STATS --> TBL
    SCORE -->|"POST /score"| INF_SIDE
    SCORE --> TBL
    WS -->|"broadcast on flag"| CLIENT
```

## Feature Engineering Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    RAW["Raw Transaction\ntransaction_id\nuser_id\namount\nmerchant_category\nlocation {lat,lng}\ntimestamp\ndevice\ncard_present"]

    subgraph FE["consumer/features.py"]
        direction TB
        F1["amount\n(pass-through)"]
        F2["hour_of_day\ntimestamp.hour"]
        F3["is_weekend\nweekday ≥ 5"]
        F4["amount_vs_user_avg\namount ÷ rolling avg"]
        F5["txns_last_5min\nsliding window count"]
        F6["distance_from_home_km\nhaversine(lat,lng → home)"]
        F7["merchant_category_encoded\nlabel encoding"]
    end

    STATE[("UserState\n(in-memory dict)\n→ Redis at prod scale")]
    VEC["Feature Vector\n[7 floats]\nFEATURE_ORDER"]
    ONNX["ONNX IsolationForest\nonnxruntime"]
    CALIB["Sigmoid Calibration\nexpit(-(score - μ) / σ)\n→ [0, 1] anomaly prob"]
    OUT["anomaly_score\ndecision\nflag | review | clear"]

    RAW --> F1 & F2 & F3
    RAW --> F4 & F5 & F6 & F7
    STATE -->|"rolling avg\ntimestamps\nhome location"| F4 & F5 & F6
    F1 & F2 & F3 & F4 & F5 & F6 & F7 --> VEC
    VEC --> ONNX
    ONNX -->|"raw score"| CALIB
    CALIB --> OUT
```

## Transaction Lifecycle (sequence)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant G as Generator
    participant K as Kafka
    participant C as Consumer
    participant I as Inference Sidecar
    participant P as PostgreSQL
    participant A as REST API
    participant D as Dashboard

    G->>K: produce(transaction_json)
    K-->>C: consume message
    C->>I: POST /score {raw_transaction}
    Note over I: engineer_features()<br/>ONNX infer<br/>sigmoid calibrate
    I-->>C: {anomaly_score, decision, features_used}
    C->>P: INSERT transaction_audit
    Note over P: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
    D->>A: GET /api/transactions
    A->>P: SELECT * ORDER BY created_at DESC
    P-->>A: rows
    A-->>D: JSON array

    alt decision = 'flag'
        C->>P: (already written above)
        A->>A: broadcast via WS manager
        A-->>D: WS push {flagged_transaction}
        Note over D: Red highlight<br/>fraud_type shown
    end
```
